labels.note: The questions were agent-authored over real documents and the question classes are agent-assigned; no human has approved either.

provenance.pool_produced_by: scripts/ab_remote_contextual.py --stage pools/rerank --arm C (BGE-M3 + bge-reranker-v2-m3, production chunking)

config.baseline_arm: GR-0.3 phase C contexts at top-5, no expansion
expansion: section boundary as far as the pool carries it
config.grouping: (document, heading path) parsed from the production contextual header
config.ordering: supported section > unreadable header > isolated neighbour; the reranker's order is kept inside each tier
config.section_strength: sum of 1/(1+rank) over the section's members in the neighbourhood, divided by the strongest section's
config.metrics: evaluation.ragas_eval.context_precision / context_recall (keyword, the phase C code path)
config.rounding: per case to 4 decimals, then the mean, then 4 decimals

header_parse.note: 'unparsed' is a header this arm cannot read and therefore does not group, demote or drop; 'sectionless' is a chunk of a document with no markdown headings, which is a section of its own; 'clamped' is a header the producer cut at 'clamp' characters, whose heading path — and therefore whose section key — may be truncated mid-text.

naive_top_k.note: Fixed truncation of the same pool, as the reference every narrowing arm has to beat: an arm that ends with four documents per case is not an improvement if 'keep the first four' is. top_k equal to the baseline's reproduces the baseline exactly.

headline.selection_rule: the grid cell with the highest aggregate context precision among the cells whose keyword FULL is not below the baseline's and whose MISS is not above it; if no cell qualifies, there is no headline and the grid is the result
headline.outcome: the best cell that costs no keyword coverage; the whole grid is published beside it
